Make musical memories for a lifetime

The Synchrony Music & Sound credit card helps make it possible to get what you need – from guitars to sound equipment to woodwinds – to start playing today.*

Music credit cards

Looking for the best instruments and equipment to bring your creative projects to life? Our Synchrony Music & Sound credit card, Guitar Center Gear Card, and Sweetwater Card are there for you.* They can help you get the music-making tools and equipment you need by offering:

  • Convenient monthly payments
  • Exclusive promotional financing offers*
  • Simple application process with almost instant credit decisions
  • $0 Fraud Liability for 100% protection from theft or loss
